document: Senior Fullstack Developer at Visuado (January 2022 - Present). Visuado is a next-generation visualization platform enabling virtual apartment tours, helping buyers decide faster and developers sell more efficiently. Led Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure for scalable deployments. Built a public TypeScript API with automated OpenAPI specs and Keycloak authentication. Designed and developed an admin platform in Vue.js to streamline internal operations. Established CI/CD pipelines and QA tools for unit testing and automation. Maintained observability tools including Grafana, Prometheus, Slack alerts and Sentry for monitoring. Managed organizational NPM libraries and async systems via custom queueing brokers. Authored and maintained the company wiki for documentation and onboarding. Led integration projects with third-party systems and clients. Key projects: Kubernetes on AWS EKS, TypeScript API with Node.js, CI/CD pipeline automation, Vue.js admin platform, Keycloak authentication, AWS infrastructure management, Grafana and Prometheus monitoring, Sentry bug tracking.
